question: The characteristic Rovsing sign in acute appendicitis consists of:

options.opa: Pain in the epigastric pressure when applying a firm and persistent pressure on McBurney's point.
options.opb: Acute pain that appears when the appendix is ​​compressed between the abdominal wall and the iliac crest.
options.opc: Passive rebound sensitivity in the abdominal wall.
options.opd: Loss of abdominal sensation when contracting the muscles of the abdominal wall.
options.ope: Pain at McBurney's point when compressing the lower left quadrant of the abdomen.
